title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 85-88 (Dhanadhanyakari, Siddhi, Strainasaumya, Shubhaprada)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 85 to 88: Dhanadhanyakari, Siddhi, Strainasaumya, Shubhaprada, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 85 to 88 with meaning
caption: Names 85 to 88 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 85 to 88**: **Dhanadhanyakari, Siddhi, Strainasaumya, Shubhaprada**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Dhanadhanyakari, Siddhi, Strainasaumya, Shubhaprada.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

sections.h: Dhanadhanyakari: Giver of wealth and grain
p: **Dhanadhanyakari** means **Giver of wealth and grain**. Giver of wealth and grain: the two foundations of a home.
**Siddhi** means **Accomplishment**. Accomplishment and success in one's work.
**Strainasaumya** means **Gentle feminine grace**. Gentle, graceful, motherly nature.
**Shubhaprada** means **Bestower of good**. Giver of auspicious results in every undertaking.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
